[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Be mindful of surroundings and keep an eye on belongings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Use a portable charger to keep the phone charged.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Designate a meeting spot with friends.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Store the bag safely at night if camping.
